verdict.rationale: Evidence pack covers domain locking, registry lock, and WHOIS redaction, but contains no documentation of 2FA/MFA on the registrar account, scoped API credentials specific to Registrar, or IP allowlisting for API access. In fact, community evidence (cloudflare-registrar-comm-7) indicates Cloudflare API keys used for domain/DNS changes grant full account access rather than being scoped, which is the opposite of what a security engineer would want, but this isn't a vendor claim being disputed—it's simply an absence of the requested controls.
